verdict.rationale: The evidence shows bulk 'automation' of granting, document and signature workflows, done in a few clicks. Those are user-initiated one-off bulk actions, not user-configured automations that run autonomously or on a recurring schedule in the background. HRIS integrations and automated error flags are built-in adjacent features, not user-defined background automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
